newsitem.title: FINLAND: Huhtamaki sees profit rising before extras.
newsitem.headline: Huhtamaki sees profit rising before extras.

text.p: Finnish confectionery and packaging group Huhtamaki Oy on Friday clarified an earlier profit forecast by stressing that it sees a clear improvement in 1996 profit over 1995 before any extraordinary gain.
"We never include extraordinary items (in our profit outlook). It's before extraordinary items," CEO Timo Peltola told Reuters by telephone in response to a question.
The company said in its January-August report it expected "a clear profit improvement" this year over 1995; adding that divestments would generate around one billion markka in extraordinary gains.
Peltola declined to elaborate much on progress in Huhtamaki's current sale of its eye medicine business, Star, beyond saying that it is talking to an overseas party about the specialist business.
